finding.scope: (g,n)=(6,6) over C with Q-coefficients; S a reduced separated finite-type scheme atlas of Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2]; Gr^W_16 H_c^16.
finding.statement: The constant-coefficient corner Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) of a scheme atlas S of the balanced tetragonal stack Hbar^bal is atlas-dependent and can be forced to be non-Tate by adjoining a finite-etale refinement of a simply-branched balanced Hurwitz chart. Concretely, there is a connected etale-atlas component V of Hbar^bal with Gr^{15,1} Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;C) nonzero, so Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;Q) is not a direct sum of Q(-8). Hypothesis (H-S) of FND-0167 at j=8 is therefore false for some allowed S, and any C66-TATE-SUPPORT statement that asserts those base corners while quantifying over an unnamed reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas is false as written. Repair requires naming a specific atlas or passing to a stack-level compact-support mixed Hodge theory, which FND-0165 withholds.
